messages.subject: Energy Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Tom,

The Energists' retained executive-search focus across oil and gas, power, utilities, renewables and energy leadership aligns closely with my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy growth depends on regulatory credibility, institutional trust and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
